title: Lazy Learner
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: Given a string of at most 500 characters, a dictionary of up to 20000 words whose lengths total 80000, and up to 300000 queries, each query names a substring by its endpoints plus an index k and asks for the k-th lexicographically smallest dictionary word that appears as a subsequence of that substring. Long answers are truncated to ten characters, and missing ones reported.
